keywords: coach screws, coach screw sizes, M10 coach screw, HDG coach screws, coach screw vs wood screw, coach screw pilot hole

heading.en: Coach Screws Defined: Hex Head Lag Screws
heading.zh: 马车螺丝定义：六角头木螺钉

body.en: A coach screw is a heavy-duty timber screw with a hexagonal head, coarse wood thread and a pointed or partially threaded shank. It is also called a lag screw in many markets. Unlike a carriage bolt, it is installed by driving the threaded shank directly into timber; unlike a standard wood screw, it normally has a larger diameter, deeper hex head and higher tightening demand. DIN 571 is a common target reference for traditional hexagon-head wood screws, while the exact thread, head and length must be confirmed on the supplier drawing. Coach screws are used for timber frames, posts, brackets, beams, gates and masonry-connected timberwork when the screw is paired with an appropriate plug or anchor. Select diameter from the joint load and timber condition, then select a length that provides sufficient thread engagement without breaking through the far face. The screw should pass through the attached steel plate or timber member and develop its holding thread in the supporting member. For example, an M10 screw through a 6 mm bracket should leave enough embedded length for the design, not simply use a 10 mm longer screw. Coach screw is a product category, not proof of a specific load rating, coating, grade or certification. For export orders, request the diameter, length under head, thread form, head across flats, material, finish and packing specification in writing.
body.zh: 马车螺丝是一种用于木材连接的重型螺钉，具有六角头、粗牙木螺纹以及尖端或部分带螺纹的杆部。在许多市场也称为木工六角螺钉或木螺栓螺钉。它不同于马车螺栓：马车螺栓通常穿过木材并配螺母，而马车螺丝是将带螺纹的杆部直接拧入木材；它也不同于普通木螺钉，通常直径更大、六角头更深，对拧紧工具和扭矩的要求更高。DIN 571可作为传统六角头木螺钉的常用目标参考，但具体螺纹、头部尺寸和长度仍应以供应商图纸确认。马车螺丝适用于木框架、立柱、支架、梁、门以及木材与砖石连接的结构，后者需要配合合适的膨胀塞或锚固件。应根据接头荷载和木材状况选择直径，再选择长度，使有效咬合长度足够，同时避免穿透木材背面。螺钉应穿过钢板或被连接木构件，并在承力木材中形成足够的螺纹咬合。例如，螺钉穿过6毫米支架时，不能只在6毫米基础上随意增加10毫米，而应按设计所需的埋入长度确定。马车螺丝这一名称本身不代表特定承载力、涂层、材料等级或认证。出口采购时，应书面确认直径、头下长度、螺纹形式、对边尺寸、材料、表面处理和包装要求。

heading.en: Coach Screw Size Chart: M6 to M12

body.en: For general purchasing, M6, M8, M10 and M12 cover many timber-frame and outdoor fixing applications, but diameter alone does not determine performance. A practical size schedule is M6 in 50, 60, 80 and 100 mm lengths; M8 in 60, 80, 100, 120 and 150 mm; M10 in 80, 100, 120, 150 and 200 mm; and M12 in 100, 120, 150, 200 and 250 mm. These are common ordering examples, not a universal stock list or a design recommendation. Confirm whether the stated length is measured from below the head to the tip, and check whether the first section is unthreaded. The unthreaded shank can help clamp a passing member, but it also reduces the threaded length available in the supporting timber. For an M10 coach screw, specify the actual outside thread diameter, head across flats, head height, point style and thread length; do not rely only on the trade name. Metric sizing should be separated from imperial lag-screw designations because a nominal 3/8 inch screw is not interchangeable with M10. If the screw passes through a steel bracket, include the bracket thickness, washer thickness and any spacer in the length calculation. Use a washer under the hex head when the bearing surface is soft, slotted or oversized. For repeat procurement, approve a sample or dimensioned drawing before placing a container or mixed-size order.
body.zh: 日常采购中，M6、M8、M10和M12可覆盖许多木框架及户外固定用途，但直径并不能单独决定性能。可作为询价参考的常见长度包括：M6为50、60、80和100毫米；M8为60、80、100、120和150毫米；M10为80、100、120、150和200毫米；M12为100、120、150、200和250毫米。这些只是常见订货示例，不是库存清单，也不是通用设计建议。必须确认长度是从头部下方量到尖端，还是采用其他测量方式，并确认杆部前段是否无螺纹。无螺纹杆部有助于夹紧被连接构件，但也会减少承力木材中可用的有效螺纹长度。对于M10马车螺丝，应明确实际外螺纹直径、头部对边、头部高度、尖端形式和螺纹长度，不能只依赖产品名称。公制尺寸应与英制木螺钉设计分开，因为公称3/8英寸螺钉不能直接替代M10。若螺钉穿过钢制支架，应把支架厚度、垫圈厚度和间隔件厚度一起计入长度。六角头下方建议使用垫圈，尤其是在木材较软、孔槽较长或孔径偏大的情况下。重复采购时，应在下整柜或混合尺寸订单前确认样品或带尺寸图纸。

heading.en: Pilot Holes for Hardwood and Softwood
heading.zh: 硬木和软木的马车螺丝底孔

body.en: A pilot hole reduces splitting, installation torque and the risk of damaging the screw, especially near an end, edge or knot. Drill the clearance hole through the attached member first when the joint must clamp tightly. Then drill the pilot hole into the supporting timber to the required thread-engagement depth. For softwood, a typical starting point is a pilot diameter of about 0.6 to 0.7 times the screw outside diameter for the threaded section; for hardwood, start around 0.7 to 0.8 times the outside diameter. These ratios are practical industry guidance, not a substitute for testing the actual species and moisture condition. For example, an M10 screw may begin with an approximately 6 to 7 mm pilot in softwood and 7 to 8 mm in dense hardwood, while the clearance hole through the top member should be close to 10 mm if full clamping is required. A deeper or slightly larger pilot may be needed in very dense hardwood, laminated timber or dry material. Keep the drill aligned with the screw axis and clear chips from a deep hole; a hole depth around 5 to 10 mm deeper than the intended threaded penetration provides space for debris, subject to the member thickness. Do not use impact driving to force a coach screw into unprepared hardwood. Lubrication can reduce friction, but verify compatibility with the coating and timber. Always keep adequate edge and end distances to prevent splitting, and confirm the final joint with a trial assembly.
body.zh: 底孔可以减少木材开裂、安装扭矩过高以及螺钉损伤的风险，尤其适用于靠近端部、边缘或节疤的位置。当接头需要形成紧密夹紧时，应先在被连接构件上钻通孔，再在承力木材中钻入所需咬合深度的导向孔。对于软木，螺纹段底孔直径可先按螺钉外径的约0.6至0.7倍选择；对于硬木，可先按外径的约0.7至0.8倍选择。这些比例属于行业常用起始建议，不能替代对实际木种和含水状态的验证。例如，M10螺钉在软木中可先采用约6至7毫米底孔，在密实硬木中可先采用约7至8毫米底孔；若需要完整夹紧，上层被连接构件的通孔应接近10毫米。对于特别密实的硬木、层压木或干燥材料，可能需要更深或略大的底孔。钻孔时保持钻头与螺钉轴线一致，并清除深孔内的木屑；在符合构件厚度的前提下，孔深通常可比计划螺纹埋入深度多约5至10毫米，以容纳碎屑。不要使用冲击模式强行把马车螺丝拧入未经处理的硬木。润滑剂可以降低摩擦，但应先确认其与涂层及木材的兼容性。应始终保留足够的边距和端距，避免劈裂，并通过试装确认最终接头。

heading.en: Load Capacity in Withdrawal and Shear

body.en: Coach screws resist two main actions: withdrawal, which pulls the screw along its axis, and shear, which loads the screw across its axis. Withdrawal resistance is influenced by threaded embedment length, timber density, screw diameter, moisture, edge distance and installation quality. Shear resistance depends on the screw diameter and steel strength, the thickness and strength of the connected timber members, joint geometry and the possibility of timber crushing or splitting. There is no safe universal load for an M10 coach screw. A buyer should obtain a design value from the applicable timber connection method, the screw manufacturer’s test information or a qualified engineer, rather than multiply diameter by an assumed number. For design review, record the screw size, effective threaded penetration, timber species or density class, moisture exposure, member thickness, spacing, end distance and load direction. Check both withdrawal and shear, then consider combined loading, prying, vibration and repeated service. Use washers to prevent head pull-through, but do not treat a washer as a substitute for adequate timber thickness or edge distance. For structural work, specify a target standard and require documented product dimensions and material information; do not claim compliance unless it is verified. On site, keep the screw straight, avoid over-tightening and inspect for splitting, head damage or thread stripping. In Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa or Mozambique projects, local engineering requirements and the actual timber species should control the final capacity calculation.
body.zh: 马车螺丝主要承受两种作用：抗拔，即荷载沿螺钉轴线把螺钉拉出；抗剪，即荷载横向作用于螺钉。抗拔能力受有效螺纹埋入长度、木材密度、螺钉直径、含水率、边距和安装质量影响。抗剪能力则取决于螺钉直径和钢材强度、连接木构件的厚度与强度、接头几何形状，以及木材被压溃或劈裂的可能性。M10马车螺丝不存在可以安全通用的固定承载值。采购方应依据适用的木结构连接方法、螺钉制造商的试验资料或合格工程师意见取得设计值，而不能把直径乘以某个假定数字。设计复核时，应记录螺钉尺寸、有效螺纹埋入长度、木材树种或密度等级、潮湿环境、构件厚度、间距、端距和荷载方向。应同时检查抗拔和抗剪，并考虑组合荷载、撬动作用、振动及重复使用。垫圈可防止螺钉头部拉穿，但不能替代足够的木材厚度或边距。对于结构工程，应明确目标标准，并要求供应商提供经过确认的产品尺寸和材料信息；未经核实，不应宣称符合某项标准。在现场应保持螺钉垂直，避免过度拧紧，并检查木材开裂、头部损伤或螺纹滑牙。在津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非或莫桑比克项目中，最终承载力计算应以当地工程要求和实际木材树种为准。

heading.en: HDG Versus Zinc for Outdoor Decks
heading.zh: 户外平台用热浸镀锌与电镀锌比较

body.en: For an outdoor deck, coating choice should follow exposure rather than appearance alone. Zinc-plated or electro-galvanized coach screws have a relatively thin zinc layer and are generally suited to dry indoor or low-corrosion conditions. They can lose protection after cutting, driving damage or long exposure to rain, condensation and wet timber. Hot-dip galvanized, or HDG, screws carry a thicker zinc coating produced by immersion in molten zinc. HDG is normally the stronger starting choice for exterior framing, raised decks and installations exposed to recurring wet-dry cycles, but the required coating mass, thread tolerance and target standard must be stated and verified. Do not assume every product labeled galvanized has the same corrosion performance. Check whether the fastener is intended for exterior timber, whether the coating covers the head and thread, and whether the timber contains preservatives or extractives that may accelerate corrosion. Stainless steel may be considered for severe marine or chemical exposure, but it is a separate material decision and should not be presented as an automatic replacement. Use compatible washers, brackets and nuts where possible; a dissimilar-metal assembly can create galvanic corrosion in a wet environment. Keep cut edges, damaged coating and standing water under review. For shipments through Beira or Durban, the buyer should specify packaging that limits salt-laden air and condensation during transit, then store cartons dry and off the floor. Coating thickness is not a substitute for correct drainage, detailing and periodic inspection of the deck.
body.zh: 户外平台的表面处理应根据使用环境选择，而不能只看外观。镀锌或电镀锌马车螺丝的锌层相对较薄，通常适用于干燥室内或低腐蚀环境；在切割、拧入造成涂层损伤，或长期接触雨水、冷凝水和潮湿木材后，保护能力可能下降。热浸镀锌，也称HDG，是把紧固件浸入熔融锌中形成较厚锌层。对于户外木框架、架空平台以及反复经历干湿循环的安装环境，HDG通常是更合适的起点，但必须明确并核实镀层重量、螺纹配合公差和目标标准。不要认为所有标有“镀锌”的产品都具有相同的耐腐蚀性能。应确认紧固件是否用于户外木材，头部和螺纹是否均有覆盖，以及木材中的防腐剂或天然抽提物是否会加速腐蚀。严重海洋或化学腐蚀环境可考虑不锈钢，但这是独立的材料选择，不能自动视为替代方案。应尽量使用相容的垫圈、支架和螺母；潮湿环境中，不同金属组合可能产生电偶腐蚀。应注意切口、受损涂层和积水位置。经贝拉或德班运输的货物，采购方应规定能减少盐雾空气和运输冷凝水影响的包装，并在到货后将纸箱置于干燥、离地位置。镀层厚度不能替代正确排水、结构细节和定期检查。

body.en: Prepare the joint before applying torque. Use a tape measure, square, marked drill bit, clearance drill, pilot drill, socket driver and a calibrated torque wrench for controlled work. Select a socket that fully engages the hex head; a loose socket can round the head, while an impact driver can exceed the timber’s crushing or the screw’s torsional limit before the operator notices. Mark the hole position, drill the clearance hole through the passing member, drill the pilot hole to the required depth, remove chips and align the members. Start the coach screw by hand or at low speed so the point remains on axis. Tighten until the head and washer seat firmly and the joint is clamped; stop if the timber begins to crush, split or rotate. There is no single correct torque for all M6-M12 coach screws because torque changes with coating, lubrication, wood density, pilot-hole diameter, thread form and moisture. Any torque figure should therefore be treated as a manufacturer-verified or project-specific value. If no value is supplied, use a controlled trial on representative timber, increase torque gradually and record the point at which seating is achieved without damage. Do not use a maximum wrench setting as a target. Recheck accessible connections after settlement or vibration where the design permits, and inspect for loose heads, splitting and corrosion. For high-volume installation, standardize the bit, socket, drill depth and operator method, then document the approved setting and inspection frequency.
body.zh: 在施加扭矩前，应先准备好接头。受控安装可使用卷尺、角尺、标记钻头、通孔钻头、底孔钻头、套筒工具以及经过校准的扭矩扳手。选择能够完全啮合六角头的套筒；套筒过松会磨圆头部，而冲击起子可能在操作者察觉前就超过木材的压溃极限或螺钉的扭转极限。先标记孔位，在被连接构件上钻通孔，再在承力木材中钻至所需深度的底孔，清除木屑并校正构件。用手或低速开始拧入，使尖端保持在轴线上。继续拧紧，直到螺钉头和垫圈稳固贴合、接头形成夹紧；如果木材开始压溃、开裂或随工具转动，应立即停止。所有M6至M12马车螺丝并不存在一个通用正确扭矩，因为扭矩会受到涂层、润滑、木材密度、底孔直径、螺纹形式和含水率影响。因此，任何扭矩数值都应视为制造商验证值或项目专用值。若供应商未提供数值，应在代表性木材上进行受控试装，逐步增加扭矩，并记录在不造成损伤的情况下刚好完成贴合的值。不要把扭矩扳手的最大设定值作为目标。若设计允许，可在木材沉降或受到振动后复查可接近的连接，并检查松动头部、开裂和腐蚀。批量安装时，应统一批头、套筒、钻孔深度和操作方法，并记录批准的设定值及检查频率。

body.en: Bulk coach-screw purchasing should be controlled by a clear product schedule, not by a short description such as “M10 galvanized.” Put every size on a line with diameter, length, thread length, head dimensions, material, finish, washer requirement, target standard and acceptable dimensional tolerance. Separate sizes by carton, use readable labels and include the quantity per inner box and master carton. For mixed orders, require a packing list showing each diameter and length so the receiving team can reconcile the shipment without opening every carton. Protect finished screws from rain, condensation and abrasion with suitable inner bags or cartons; packaging should support handling but should not trap moisture against a zinc coating. For sea freight to Zimbabwe, Zambia, South Africa or Mozambique, discuss palletization, carton strength, container loading, desiccant policy and marking before production. Beira and Durban are relevant routing points, but the forwarder, port handling and final inland delivery plan should be confirmed separately. Do not treat a supplier quotation as proof of stock, production capacity or a guaranteed delivery date. Ask for a pre-production sample, dimensioned drawing, coating description and packing photos when the order is new or dimensions are critical. Agree how shortages, mixed cartons, damaged packaging and nonconforming dimensions will be recorded. A purchase order should identify the approved sample or revision number and state whether partial shipment is allowed. TradeGo can prepare a factory-direct quotation when the buyer provides sizes, estimated quantity, destination, finish and packing needs; the quotation should remain subject to written confirmation of specifications and schedule.
body.zh: 批量采购马车螺丝应由清晰的产品明细控制，而不是只写“镀锌M10”这样的简短描述。每个规格都应单独列明直径、长度、螺纹长度、头部尺寸、材料、表面处理、是否需要垫圈、目标标准和可接受的尺寸公差。不同规格应分箱包装，使用清晰标签，并标明内盒和外箱数量。混合订单应要求装箱单逐项列出直径和长度，使收货团队无需打开每个纸箱即可核对货物。成品螺丝应使用合适的内袋或纸箱防止雨水、冷凝水和摩擦；包装应便于搬运，但不应让水分长期贴附在锌层上。运往津巴布韦、赞比亚、南非或莫桑比克的海运货物，应在生产前讨论托盘化、纸箱强度、集装箱装载、防潮剂方案和唛头。贝拉和德班是相关运输节点，但货代、港口操作及最终内陆运输计划应另行确认。不要把供应商报价视为现货、产能或保证交期的证明。新订单或尺寸要求严格时，应索取产前样品、带尺寸图纸、镀层说明和包装照片。双方还应约定短装、混箱、包装破损和尺寸不符的记录方式。采购订单应标明已批准的样品或版本号，并说明是否允许分批装运。当买方提供尺寸、预估数量、目的地、表面处理和包装要求后，TradeGo可以准备工厂直供报价；但报价仍应以书面确认的规格和交期为准。
